picks.title: STUNet-Fusion: Spatiotemporal Needle-Tip Localization in Ultrasound Video via Multi-Channel Motion Fusion
picks.takeaway: 融合灰度、网格运动与帧差三通道，ConvLSTM+U-Net 回归针尖热图。
picks.why: 针对针尖弱/不可见等真实超声难题，视频级时空建模。

picks.title: Evolving Error States: Failure-Aware Progressive Repair for Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
picks.takeaway: 将分割掩膜建模为动态失败状态，渐进修复超声病灶分割错误。
picks.why: 关注高均值精度掩盖的临床关键错误，思路具通用性。

picks.title: AlignUS: MRI-Guided Ultrasound Representation Learning for ALS Classification from Tongue Images
picks.takeaway: 跨模态蒸馏将 MRI 解剖知识迁入舌部超声分类器，推理仅需超声。
picks.why: 面向低资源 ALS 评估，用可携带超声替代 MRI，具临床价值。

picks.title: Concept-Grounded Reasoning with Prompt-Driven Localization for Interpretable Structured Report Generation
picks.takeaway: CORAL 将空间定位与概念级监督融入统一推理，生成可解释报告。
picks.why: 针对超声/X 光结构化报告，强调临床中间属性建模与可解释。
